children: Arkham said Bitwise's BHYP client did not buy any HYPE for four consecutive days. According to ChainCatcher, the client bought $10.5 million worth of HYPE on Friday, the largest single-day purchase since Aug. 27, when it bought $23.2 million.
Arkham said Bitwise has accumulated $166.3 million in HYPE since launch, making BHYP the largest HYPE ETF by size.

title: Bitwise's BHYP Buys $10.5 Million in HYPE After Four-Day Pause
